Dashboard objects

Source: R/dashboard.R
DASHBOARD-class.Rd

A DASHBOARD object holds a shiny dashboard: its items (inputs, outputs and containers), its layout and the R code of its services. It is usually made from a YAML, JSON or R list configuration with rvisDashboard(), and run with its run() method or runDashboard().

Fields

name

Name of the dashboard.

items

Named list of the items. Each item is a list with a type and the settings of that type; see the item reference.

king.layout

The item(s) making the page (field layout of a configuration).

objects

Objects copied into session$userData of each session.

values

Initial values of the reactive list sync of each session.

prescript, observers

R code run at the start of each session, and in observers.

settings, messages, loginTable

Settings, messages and users of dashboards with a login item.

Methods

run(...)

Runs the dashboard (arguments are passed to shiny::runApp()).

app(...)

Returns the shiny app object.

dashboard.ui(), dashboard.server()

Return the user interface and the server function.

updateItem4Session(item, session, ...)

Updates an input item in a session (like shiny::updateSelectInput()); usable in services.

updateItem(item, ...)

Updates an input item in all open sessions (needs setting keepSessions).

hideItems(...), showItems(...), enableItems(...), disableItems(...)

Hide, show, enable or disable items (package shinyjs); usable in services.

itemRole(i)

Role of item i: "input", "output" or "container".

See also

rvisDashboard, runDashboard, rvisDashboardExample, and the dashboards guide.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dash <- rvisDashboard(rvisDashboardExample("hello"))
class(dash)
names(dash$items)
dash$run()
} # }
